_doc: Bodzas-2023 -> GR-Neutro class mapping. Bodzas WBC dataset (Bodzas, Kodytek, Zidek, Scientific Data 10:466, 2023; figshare DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.c.6612970) has 9 cell types from peripheral blood smears. Only 'neutrophil_segment' maps cleanly to a GR-Neutro Normal target. 'neutrophil_band' is physiologically banded; same caveat as MLL-23 (target=Hyposegmentation, audit_required=true). All non-neutrophil source classes are OOV w.r.t. the GR-Neutro 7-class neutrophil-morphology label space.
_abnormalities_partially_evaluable: Hyposegmentation (via neutrophil_band, audit_required=true; same convention as MLL-23 map)

neutrophil_segment.notes: Mature segmented PMN; direct match to GR-Neutro Normal. Equivalent to MLL-23 neutrophil_segmented.

neutrophil_band.notes: Band cells are physiologically hyposegmented (<3 lobes). Same audit flag as MLL-23 neutrophil_band; lab may relabel as Normal.

eosinophil.notes: Eosinophil; granulocyte but NOT neutrophil. Rejection pool.

basophil.notes: Basophil; granulocyte but NOT neutrophil. Rejection pool.

nucleated_red_blood_cell.notes: Normoblast / nucleated RBC; erythroid lineage; rejection pool.

myeloblast.notes: Blast; not a mature neutrophil. Rejection pool.

lymphoblast.notes: Lymphoid blast; not a mature neutrophil. Rejection pool.
